code:class:CircuitState.definition: The three states of a circuit breaker: CLOSED passes traffic, OPEN rejects it outright, HALF_OPEN admits a limited probe to test whether the dependency recovered.

code:class:CircuitConfig.definition: Tunables for a CircuitBreaker: the consecutive failure count that trips the circuit, how long it stays open before probing, the probe budget in half-open, and the exponential-backoff bounds used when retrying.

code:class:DeadLetter.definition: A work item that exhausted its retries. Records the worm name, its arguments, the error text, a timestamp, and a retry count so the queue can be inspected and replayed rather than silently dropped.

code:class:Candidate.definition: One proposed solution in a meta-evolution population: a genome together with the fitness it achieved, kept so the next generation can select on and recombine from it.

code:class:BackendBandit.definition: Multi-armed bandit that picks an inference backend using a seed-initialised PRNG and per-(model, backend) success/failure statistics, so backend choice is driven by observed throughput rather than fixed configuration.

code:class:League.definition: Elo-style rating league. Maintains a float rating per player, updated from head-to-head results with a K-factor, and optionally persists across runs.

code:class:ComputeBandit.definition: Bandit that selects a compute tier or device for a job based on recorded success and token-throughput history rather than a static preference order.

code:class:SearchResult.definition: One search hit: title, URL, snippet and the provider that returned it. Frozen so a result cannot be mutated after the fact by a consumer.

code:class:FetchResult.definition: The outcome of fetching a URL: the requested and final URL (after redirects), HTTP status, extracted text and any error, so a caller can tell a failed fetch from an empty page.

code:class:HealthCheck.definition: A single named liveness probe and its result, used to report subsystem health as data rather than by raising.

code:class:TokenKind.definition: The interpolation modes a SQL template may use: LITERAL for inline text, VALUE for a bound parameter, IDENT for a quoted identifier, and RAW for direct injection.

code:class:Token.definition: One parsed piece of a SQL template: its kind, the raw text, any bound value, and the source expression it was built from.

code:class:StepStatus.definition: Lifecycle state of a workflow step: PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS or FAILED.

code:class:WorkflowStep.definition: One step of a workflow: an id, the action to perform such as execute_worm or run_pipeline, and the parameters passed to it.

code:class:Tier.definition: Top-level capability band a module belongs to: SYSTEM, ASSISTANT, ML or KNOWLEDGE.

code:class:Category.definition: Finer-grained module grouping, one step below Tier, used to organise the registry and reporting.

code:class:ModuleType.definition: The role a module plays in the system: CORE, MANAGER, ORCHESTRATOR, ADAPTER and the other structural kinds.

code:class:ModuleSpec.definition: The declaration of one module: its name, the tier and category it belongs to, and its structural type.

code:class:PythonInstallation.definition: One discovered Python interpreter on the machine, with its path, version and free-threaded status, so the manager can reason about 3.13 vs 3.14t rather than assuming a single interpreter.

code:class:PythonManager.definition: Discovers and selects among installed Python interpreters. The project mandates 3.14t, so the manager is what keeps every workload on the free-threaded build.

code:class:ThreatAlert.definition: A raised threat signal describing a suspicious pattern detected by the monitoring worm, with its severity and the evidence that triggered it.

code:class:ThreatSnapshot.definition: A point-in-time capture of threat state, so two snapshots can be diffed to show what changed between observations.

code:class:InspectionResult.definition: The outcome of inspecting a worm cluster: which members were found, their health, and any discrepancy between the declared and the actual membership.

code:class:WormFleet.definition: A managed set of worm instances with shared lifecycle control, so a fleet can be started, health-checked and stopped as a unit rather than process by process.

code:class:WormGenome.definition: The encoded traits of a morphing worm, used to derive mutations and to reason about what a variant is.

code:class:MorphingWorm.definition: A worm whose behaviour is derived from a mutable genome rather than hardcoded, so it can adapt across runs.

code:class:MorphingWormV2.definition: Second-generation morphing worm, reworking the genome representation and mutation strategy of MorphingWorm.

code:class:OMNIV2.definition: The v2 general-purpose worm, a consolidation of capabilities that earlier omni worms kept separate.

code:class:DnsWorm.definition: Worm that performs DNS lookups and related name resolution checks, reporting results back as evidence.

code:class:DiagnosticWorm.definition: Worm that runs diagnostic checks across the system and reports findings without mutating anything.

code:class:FastErrorScanner.definition: Quick source scan for error-handling defects, tuned for speed over completeness -- the counterpart to the full ERRORZ analysis.

code:class:EchoAgent.definition: Minimal agent that echoes its input. Used as a liveness probe for the agent runtime, not as a working agent.

code:class:AzazaelNode.definition: A node in the Azazael distributed topology, carrying identity and the links that place it in the network.

code:class:PolicyEffect.definition: The observed effect of applying a compliance policy: what it permitted, what it denied, and any exemptions granted, recorded as evidence for the 0X/0Y checks.

code:class:AzazaelStressTest.definition: Load harness for the system, used to find the limits that ordinary functional tests never reach.

code:class:StressResult.definition: Outcome of a stress run: what was exercised, the throughput reached, and where it began to degrade.

code:class:_CrossNatureRoute.definition: A computed path between two natures in the cluster, carrying the hops that make the route and its cost.

code:class:ArchiveSystemWorm.definition: Archives and restores working files with provenance, using copy-don't-move and byte verification.

code:class:ComprehensiveFixWorm.definition: Runs the comprehensive repair pass over a project, applying audited fixes with rollback.

code:class:DebugRunnerWorm.definition: Multi-agent test runner: dispatches failing cases to several agents and compares their diagnoses.

code:class:EnvironUpdaterWorm.definition: Reconciles tool environment variables and PATH so a tool behaves the same standalone and in the fleet.

code:class:EnvironmentManagerWorm.definition: Manages per-project environment setup and teardown, including env files and secrets wiring.

code:class:ErrorzWorm.definition: Static analysis worm that finds error-handling defects and missing-documentation patterns across the tree.

code:class:HealthzWorm.definition: System health probe exposing a liveness signal other components and operators can check.

code:class:LspDiagnosisWorm.definition: Collects language-server diagnostics for hover and completion failures that would otherwise be silent.

code:class:MetriczWorm.definition: Records and surfaces metrics for the system, feeding the learning monitor and the metrics registry.

code:class:MonitorLearningWorm.definition: Dashboard for the learning loop -- live window, LAN page and rolling log of reward and fitness cycles.

code:class:PythonMapperQuickWorm.definition: Fast, read-only survey of the Python installations and import layout on the machine.

code:class:PythonSystemMapperFullWorm.definition: Exhaustive Python system map -- every interpreter, package and site, for audits.

code:class:PythonSystemMapperWorm.definition: Standard-depth Python system map, between the quick and full survey variants.

code:class:QLAnalysisWorm.definition: Q-learning analysis: reads the learning tables and reports what the policy has actually learned.

code:class:QwythosProxyWorm.definition: Local HTTP proxy for traffic inspection and request interception.

code:class:TrimzWorm.definition: Trims and normalises text and structured output to a known shape before it is consumed downstream.

code:class:_CtlExecOnlyA.definition: Control fixture A: execution-permitted governance case.

code:class:_CtlExecOnlyB.definition: Control fixture B: execution-permitted governance case, counterpart to _CtlExecOnlyA.

code:class:_CtlSameNameA.definition: Control fixture A for the identical-name governance case, where two candidates share a name.

code:class:_CtlSameNameB.definition: Control fixture B for the identical-name governance case, counterpart to _CtlSameNameA.

code:class:_CtlTwinA.definition: Control fixture A for the twin-worm governance case.

code:class:_CtlTwinB.definition: Control fixture B for the twin-worm governance case.

code:method:_dev.definition: Lazily resolves and caches the compute device, falling back to CPU when CORE.device is unavailable, so a missing device module degrades rather than crashes.

code:method:_build.definition: Constructs the ensemble of randomly initialised networks the oracle scores against. Seeds each model separately (`seed + 1000*k`) so the ensemble is reproducible but its members differ.

code:method:dfs.definition: Depth-first traversal of the step dependency graph that detects cycles: a node reached while still on the recursion stack is a back edge, which makes the workflow unexecutable and must be reported rather than recursed into forever.

code:method:_key.definition: Cache key for an embedding: SHA-256 over the model name and text joined by a NUL separator, so the same text under a different model is a different entry and the separator cannot be forged by text content.

code:method:do_GET.definition: HTTP request handler for the metrics endpoint, serving the registry's Prometheus exposition and the health response depending on the requested path.

code:method:register.definition: Registers a metric definition with the registry, including its type and label set, so values recorded against it can be exported.

code:method:is_open.definition: Whether the circuit is currently rejecting calls. A half-open circuit is not open -- it admits a limited probe -- so the answer is state, not the inverse of a boolean flag.

code:method:reset.definition: Returns the breaker to its closed state and clears accumulated failures and the dead letter queue, for tests and manual recovery.

code:method:get.definition: Mapping-style read of a recorded value by key, with a default when absent.

code:method:check_bom.definition: Detects a byte-order mark at the start of a file, which breaks Python source parsing in a way that surfaces as a confusing syntax error rather than an encoding one.

code:method:remove_bom.definition: Strips a leading byte-order mark from a file in place, the repair half of check_bom.

code:method:save_report.definition: Writes the scanner's findings to a report file so a scan leaves evidence rather than only console output.

code:method:get_all.definition: Snapshot of every currently known thread entry, used by introspection and health reporting.

code:method:run_all.definition: Runs every registered callable concurrently across the free-threaded pool and returns the collected results.

code:function:get_int.definition: Reads an integer hyperparameter from the tuning config, falling back to `default` when unset or unparseable.

code:function:load.definition: Loads a hyperparameter configuration from disk for the optimiser to sweep.

code:function:_make.definition: Constructs the probe fixture used to exercise the filesystem-watch path.

code:function:_run.definition: Executes a command under a timeout and returns its result, bounding the probe so a hung command cannot stall the check.

code:method:map.definition: Applies a function across the agent's inputs, keeping results aligned with what was passed in.

code:method:close.definition: Releases the agent's resources, terminating anything it started so nothing is left running after the agent is done.

code:method:start.definition: Starts the periodic compliance audit loop.

code:method:stop.definition: Stops the periodic compliance audit loop and joins the worker so no audit outlives its owner.

code:method:_log.definition: Single funnel every logging method routes through, so level, script attribution and formatting are applied in one place.

code:function:log.definition: Module-level logging helper for the cluster worms.

code:function:era_descriptor._f.<locals>.definition: Local float-coercing accessor over the parsed oracle payload: returns the value for `key` as a float, and 0.0 rather than raising when it is missing or not numeric.

code:class:_run_watch_mode.ScanEventHand.definition: Handles events raised during an anti-pattern scan, so policy can react to findings as they are produced rather than only at the end.
